mainEntity.name: Can I convert a wood-burning fire-bowl to natural gas or propane?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it is often possible to convert a wood-burning fire-bowl to natural gas or propane, provided the fire-bowl material is compatible and can safely house a gas burner. This conversion typically involves installing a gas burner kit, connecting to a gas line (natural gas) or propane tank, and ensuring proper ventilation. Professional assessment is crucial to confirm feasibility and safety, as not all wood-burning units are suitable for conversion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, many wood-burning fire-bowls can be converted to natural gas or propane by installing a gas burner kit, though professional assessment is needed for safety and compatibility.
